content: Sabbath a pha vaengah Jesuh tah Pharisee boeilu pakhat im ah buh ca la cet. Te vaengah amah te a om thil uh tih a dawn uh.
Te vaengah hlang pakhat bungthung aka khueh te a hmaiah pakcak a pawk pah.
Te dongah Jesuh loh olming rhoek neh Pharisee rhoek te a doo tih a voek vaengah, “

content.text: Sabbath hnin ah tloh hoeih sak ham tueng a, a tueng moenih a?

content: Tedae amih loh a hil a phah uh dongah a hoeih sak hlang te a mawt tih a tueih.

content.text: Na ca mai khaw, vaito mai khaw tangrhom ah aka cungku te, Sabbath hnin ah pahoi a doek moenih a?

content: Tedae te te oelh uh thai pawh.
Hmuensang te mat a laehdawn tih aka tuek, a cael rhoek te nuettahnah a thui pah.

content: A yaak uh vaengah aka ngol rhoek khuikah pakhat loh, “Yoethen long te tah Pathen kah ram ah buh a caak ni,” a ti nah.

content: Jesuh te hlangping loh muep a puei hatah, amih taengla mael tih,

content.text: Khat khat te kai taengla ha lo vaengah a napa neh a manu, a yuu neh a ca, pacaboeina neh tanu takhong, amah kah a hinglu khaw a toeng thil bal pawt atah ka hnukbang la om ham a coeng moenih

Nangmih khui lamkah loh imsang sak ham aka ngaih te unim? Lamhma la ngol tih a hnonah te a tae moenih a? Imcoeng ham khueh mai cakhaw

hlang loh sak hamla a tong dae a coeng thai moenih
